acceptanceCriteria: a line shift in a file cited from docs/RELEASE-NOTES-*.md fails make line-citations-check locally, proven by a mutation
DCG-V0-001's document set in the spec matches the checked set
body: Observed 2026-10-16 on PR #955 (head 4f52f146a): a 30-line insertion in docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md moved the trust-roots sentence, so docs/RELEASE-NOTES-alpha.md:127's citation `docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md:255-256@012d2dcc` no longer landed on it. line-citations-check (document set DCG-V0-001) and all other local doc gates passed; only CI's conformance/release-artifact-v0 TestReleaseNotesCEMTrustCitationLandsOnTrustRoots caught it (fixed in b5d8b1d14 by repointing to 285-286). Expected: the local doc gate reports the drift. Fix options: add release-notes files to the DCG-V0-001 document set, or a check that every `path:a-b@hash` anchor in tracked docs still resolves. Related but distinct: V1-0237 (BUILD-LOG citation shifts).
title: line-citations-check does not cover docs/RELEASE-NOTES-*.md: a cited-file line shift passes every local doc gate and fails only in CI
